Hurdle contrasts: intensity and detection combined with Fisher's method

Source: R/ContrastsHurdle.R
ContrastsHurdleFacade.Rd

Hurdle contrasts: intensity and detection combined with Fisher's method

Hurdle contrasts: intensity and detection combined with Fisher's method

Value

An R6 class generator.

Details

Joins the contrasts of a fitted intensity facade (e.g. lm_impute) and a fitted detection facade (firth_nested, binomial_nested or binomial_firth_nested) by subject and contrast, and replaces p.value and FDR with Fisher's combined test, as in msqrob2's hypothesisTestHurdle. No model is fitted.

For each subject and contrast, \(X^2 = -2 \sum \log p\) over the available component p-values, with two degrees of freedom per component, so a row with a single component keeps that component's p-value. The detection p-value is left out for subjects whose child features are detected in every sample, because detection carries no information there. FDR is the Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment within each contrast.

diff, avgAbd, std.error, statistic, df, the confidence interval, sigma and estimate_type come from the intensity component. They are NA for subjects only the detection component estimates; with lm these are the proteins detected in one group only, so filter_significant() and get_ora() drop them. Pair with lm_impute, which estimates their diff.

Added columns: p.value.intensity, FDR.intensity, diff.detection (log odds ratio), p.value.detection, FDR.detection (all as reported by the components), chisq.hurdle, df.hurdle, and hurdle_components (both, intensity or detection: the p-values combined).

Examples

istar <- sim_lfq_data_peptide_config(Nprot = 20, weight_missing = 0.5, seed = 3)
#> creating sampleName from file_name column
#> completing cases
#> completing cases done
#> setup done
lfq_peptide <- LFQData$new(istar$data, istar$config)
lfq_peptide <- lfq_peptide$get_Transformer()$log2()$lfq
#> Column added : log2_abundance
lfq_protein <- lfq_peptide$get_Aggregator()$aggregate()
#> starting aggregation
#> Warning: medpolish() did not converge in 10 iterations
#> completing cases
contrasts <- c("A_vs_Ctrl" = "group_A - group_Ctrl")
intensity <- build_contrast_analysis(lfq_protein, "~ group_", contrasts, method = "lm_impute")
detection <- build_contrast_analysis(lfq_peptide, "~ group_", contrasts, method = "binomial_nested")
#> completing cases
hurdle <- ContrastsHurdleFacade$new(intensity, detection)
#> determine linear functions:
#> get_contrasts -> contrasts_linfct
#> contrasts_linfct
#> Joining with `by = join_by(protein_Id, contrast)`
#> determine linear functions:
#> get_contrasts -> contrasts_linfct
#> contrasts_linfct
#> Joining with `by = join_by(protein_Id, contrast)`
res <- hurdle$get_contrasts()
#> completing cases
table(res$hurdle_components)
#> 
#>      both intensity 
#>        17         3 
head(res)
